name: Multi-Channel ROI Profiling
description:
Perform a targeted multi-channel intensity analysis on the 'Fluorescent Cells' sample image. 

Your goal is to measure the signal intensity of the Red, Green, and Blue channels specifically within 3 distinct nuclei.

Steps:
1. Open the 'Fluorescent Cells' sample (File > Open Samples > Fluorescent Cells).
2. Convert the RGB image to a Stack (Image > Type > RGB Stack) so channels become separate slices.
3. Navigate to Slice 3 (Blue) to clearly see the nuclei.
4. Use the selection tools to outline 3 distinct, complete nuclei and add them to the ROI Manager (Analyze > Tools > ROI Manager).
5. Configure measurements to include 'Area' and 'Mean Gray Value' (Analyze > Set Measurements).
6. Use the ROI Manager's 'Multi Measure' command to measure these ROIs across all 3 slices of the stack.
7. Save the resulting table as 'nuclei_stack_profiles.csv' to '~/ImageJ_Data/results/'.

The output file must show measurements for each ROI on Slice 1, Slice 2, and Slice 3.
